The target video uses a cinematic, live-action urban drama style with warm afternoon office corridor lighting, transitioning from hopeful to ominous.
[Shot 1] A medium shot of an office corridor within <Subject 7>. <Subject 4>, Zhao Jianguo, calls out to <Subject 1>, Chen Mo, who is walking ahead. The camera holds on a two-shot of them in the corridor. <Subject 4> looks him up and down — taking in the white shirt, the rolled sleeves. Zhao Jianguo (S4) asks: <d>[Chinese] 你以前干过这行？</d> Chen Mo (S1) pauses, then says: <d>[Chinese] ……做过几年。</d> [Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the camera cuts to a medium close-up of <Subject 4>. He nods slowly. Zhao Jianguo (S4) says in a decisive tone: <d>[Chinese] 从明天起，你调到创意部。</d> He pauses. <d>[Chinese] 盛鼎的比稿，你主笔。</d> <Subject 1> nods. Chen Mo (S1) says quietly: <d>[Chinese] 谢谢赵总。</d> <Subject 4> turns and walks two steps, then stops and looks back over his shoulder. Zhao Jianguo (S4) says with a hint of warmth: <d>[Chinese] 你那个白衬衫，以后常穿。</d> He walks away. [Shot 3] At 00:09.500, the camera cuts to a medium shot of <Subject 1> standing alone in the corridor. <Subject 2>, Su Nian, appears from the side, her eyes bright and sparkling. Su Nian (S2), a young woman with a clear, slightly breathy voice, says with excitement: <d>[Chinese] 陈默！你太厉害了！</d> Chen Mo (S1) says flatly, without expression change: <d>[Chinese] 方案是你先提案的。功劳算你一半。</d> <Subject 2> freezes for a beat, then laughs — a genuine, surprised laugh. His face is dark — a deep, simmering fury. The camera pushes in slowly to a close-up of his eyes. Wang Defa (S3), a middle-aged man with a thin, oily voice, says through gritted teeth: <d>[Chinese] 一个打杂的……凭什么？</d> The camera holds on his dark, dangerous stare as the video ends.
